name: Branding Smite
description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the weapon gleams with astral radiance as you strike. The attack deals an extra 2d6 radiant damage to the target.
effect: Your next weapon hit deals +2d6 radiant (concentration).
notes: In combat (bonus action): your next weapon hit, melee or ranged, deals +2d6 radiant. Concentration.
